title: Remove Recursive Run ID Scan From Audit Package Validator

context.target_pr: PR #2 Add audit package loader/validator, CLI validate-package command, and tests
already_fixed: _read_text_file converts UnicodeDecodeError and OSError into AuditPackageLoadError
JSON and JSONL readers reuse deterministic text reader
context.remaining_blocker: _collect_run_ids still calls recursive _find_run_ids over arbitrary nested dict/list values, which violates A-005R2/A-005R2b and can falsely reject valid packages that contain nested metadata/reference/baseline run IDs.

task.summary: Remove recursive run_id scanning from the audit package validator and add regression tests proving nested non-canonical run IDs do not fail validation.
task.user_story: As an Ailuros maintainer, I want run_id consistency validation to check only canonical package fields so referenced/baseline/metadata run IDs do not cause false governance failures.
non_goals: Do not change summary.md read-error handling except if tests require a tiny adjustment.
Do not change PASS, REVIEW_REQUIRED, FAIL semantics.
Do not add new package schema features.
Do not add HTTP API, dashboard, runtime ingestion, runtime blocking, auth, sessions, or policy DSL.
Do not introduce Clarify/EverRun/radarCreation/browser/UI/domain-specific concepts into src/ailuros.
Do not rewrite unrelated exporter formatting or CLI formatting.

forbidden_paths: src/ailuros/cli.py unless a failing test proves it is necessary

required_changes: Delete _find_run_ids if it becomes unused, or leave it only if another existing caller still needs it; it must not participate in package consistency validation.
Implement _collect_run_ids using only direct canonical fields.
Canonical singleton fields: manifest.run_id and run.run_id when manifest/run are JSON objects.
Canonical list record fields: timeline[*].run_id, decisions[*].run_id, evaluations[*].run_id, regressions[*].run_id when each item is a JSON object.
Ignore all nested run_id keys under metadata, payload, baseline, previous, reference, compared, evidence, details, or any nested object/list that is not the direct record object.
Preserve missing run_id checks for manifest.json and run.json.
Preserve direct canonical mismatch failure for timeline/decisions/evaluations/regressions records.
Preserve current summary.md structured read handling.

suggested_code_shape.collect: def _collect_run_ids(package: AuditPackage) -> list[str]: collect _top_level_run_id(package.manifest), _top_level_run_id(package.run), then extend _record_list_run_ids(package.timeline/decisions/evaluations/regressions)
suggested_code_shape.list_helper: def _record_list_run_ids(value: Any) -> list[str]: if not list return []; for each item, append _top_level_run_id(item) when present
suggested_code_shape.anti_pattern: Do not walk nested values recursively. Do not call a helper that recursively scans every dict/list.

required_tests: A package with decisions[*].metadata.run_id different from canonical run_id still returns PASS when no direct canonical mismatch exists.
A package with evaluations[*].baseline.run_id or referenced_run_id different from canonical run_id still returns PASS when no direct canonical mismatch exists.
A package with regressions[*].details.previous.run_id different from canonical run_id still returns PASS when no direct canonical mismatch exists.
A package with timeline[*].run_id different from manifest/run direct run_id still returns FAIL.
A package with decisions[*].run_id different from manifest/run direct run_id still returns FAIL.
Existing invalid UTF-8 / malformed JSON / malformed JSONL / block / review tests still pass.

acceptance_criteria: _collect_run_ids does not call _find_run_ids or any recursive arbitrary nested scanner.
Nested non-canonical run_id values under metadata/payload/baseline/reference/details are ignored for consistency validation.
Direct canonical timeline[*].run_id mismatch fails deterministically.
Direct canonical decisions[*].run_id mismatch fails deterministically.
Direct canonical evaluations[*].run_id mismatch fails deterministically.
Direct canonical regressions[*].run_id mismatch fails deterministically.
manifest.json and run.json missing run_id still fail deterministically.
summary.md structured read handling remains intact.

notes: If full pytest still fails due to unrelated Clarify/release-smoke baseline tests, report exact failing tests and do not claim full-suite success.

must_check: _collect_run_ids no longer uses recursive arbitrary nested scanning.
No helper used by _collect_run_ids recursively walks nested dict/list values looking for run_id keys.
Tests prove nested non-canonical metadata/baseline/reference/details run_id values do not cause FAIL.
Tests prove direct canonical timeline/decisions/evaluations/regressions run_id mismatches still cause FAIL.
Existing summary.md invalid UTF-8 structured failure behavior remains covered and passing.
CLI JSON output behavior remains unchanged.
No forbidden paths or application-specific concepts are introduced.
Validation commands are run and reported honestly.
reject_if: _collect_run_ids still calls _find_run_ids or equivalent recursive nested scanner.
Nested metadata.run_id, payload.run_id, baseline.run_id, referenced_run_id, or details.previous.run_id can still trigger mismatch FAIL.
Canonical direct mismatch detection is removed or weakened.
summary.md structured read handling regresses to raw read_text exceptions.
Tests are deleted, loosened, or rewritten to hide the false-positive bug.
The patch expands into unrelated architecture, docs, HTTP API, dashboard, live ingestion, runtime blocking, auth, sessions, or policy DSL.
Validation failures are hidden or reported as success.
